reason: Conversation 1 correctly identifies the hidden truth (biofilm/mould from low-temp washes, excess softener/detergent, closed door), gives safe practical steps (unplug before the filter, clean seal/drawer/filter, hot maintenance wash, leave door ajar), asks a sensible question to rule out plumbing, and appropriately defers seal replacement to 'only if it persists' rather than recommending a part.
